PAYETTE is seeking a senior architect to join our Space Strategies group, bringing expertise in space planning, programming, and lab planning. The ideal candidate leads with strategic thinking, communicates with confidence, and has a genuine passion for research and learning environments in science and engineering.
Project work spans academic campus planning, space programming, and lab planning for higher education and corporate clients. Space Strategies is an interdisciplinary group working at the intersection of planning, programming, and design. It's an exciting moment to join as we integrate new methods of analysis and capabilities into our practice.
